g.text: no input frame, kept in denominator
Comparable = valid action and window on both sides. W1/W2 = candidate windows in source-time order. Abstention states: complete, answer null, both null (answer and evidence).
Technical missing: 6 of 72 planned calls (P11_104-7, all three prompt conditions), kept in every denominator. Rows follow the frozen extension-queue rank.
